q: A named executive owns cloud risk AND spend, with authority to stop deployments.
fix: Appoint accountable executive; publish RACI; add to board charter

q: A cloud governance board meets monthly, with minuted decisions and tracked actions.
fix: Stand up board; 60-min monthly cadence; action log

q: Every cloud account sits in the central organization with a named owner.
fix: Sweep shadow accounts; enforce org SCPs; require owner at creation

q: MFA is enforced for every human identity, including root/break-glass.
fix: Enforce phishing-resistant MFA via conditional access; vault root

q: No wildcard admin policies; privileges are reviewed at least quarterly.
fix: Replace *:* with scoped roles; quarterly access recertification

q: Dormant identities are disabled within 90 days.
fix: Automate joiner-mover-leaver and 90-day dormancy disable

q: Every resource carries owner and cost-center tags, enforced at deploy time.
fix: Tag-or-deny policy; backfill from CMDB; showback reports

q: Every account has a budget with alerts routed to the cost owner.
fix: Budget-per-account via IaC baseline; alert to owner not mailbox

q: Idle and orphaned resources are reviewed and reclaimed monthly.
fix: Auto-schedule dev/test; rightsizing review; reclaim owner-less assets

q: No storage is publicly reachable without a time-boxed, approved exception.
fix: Block public access at org level; exception register with expiry

q: All data stores are encrypted at rest with managed keys and rotation.
fix: Enable default encryption; deny unencrypted creates; rotate keys

q: Continuous control monitoring reports to executives against a named framework.
fix: Deploy CSPM; map to framework; monthly exec scorecard

q: Data residency is technically enforced by an approved-region allow-list.
refs: GDPR Ch.V; DORA Art.28; Nigeria NDPA; FedRAMP
fix: Org-level region-deny policy; migrate or exception-register offenders

q: All data stores carry a classification label that drives controls.
fix: Classification taxonomy; auto-label; link to encryption/residency

q: Retention schedules and legal holds are defined and enforced in cloud storage.
fix: Retention policies per class; legal-hold workflow with legal team

q: Every critical workload has automated, restore-tested backups.
refs: NIST CP-9; DORA Art.12; FFIEC BCM
fix: Backup-by-default for tier-1; quarterly restore tests

q: Disaster recovery is tested at least annually with evidenced RTO/RPO.
fix: Annual DR exercise; evidence pack for regulators

q: A tested exit and portability plan exists for every critical cloud service.
fix: Exit plans per critical service; stressed-exit tabletop

q: Policy-as-code guardrails block non-compliant deployments before they land.
fix: OPA/SCP guardrails in CI and at org level

q: Infrastructure changes occur only through reviewed IaC pipelines.
fix: Remove console write access; pipeline-only deploys

q: Policy exceptions are time-boxed, approved, and expire automatically.
fix: Exception register with owner, expiry, auto-revoke

q: Provider and region concentration risk is measured and within board appetite.
fix: Set concentration appetite; multi-region for tier-1

q: Contracts give audit rights, incident notice SLAs and sub-processor visibility.
fix: Contract addendum program for top-20 providers

q: SaaS and shadow-IT inventory is complete and risk-tiered.
fix: CASB/SSPM discovery; tier and onboard
